name: FooBillard++
description:
FooBillard++ is an open-source 3D OpenGL billiards simulation game. Forked and modernized from the original FooBillard, it features realistic ball physics, reflections, and competitive game rules.

Features:
- Multiple cue sport game types including 8-ball, 9-ball, Snooker, and Carom
- Realistic 3D rigid-body physics simulation including ball spin, jump, and English
- Singleplayer practice mode and competitive matches against intelligent AI opponents
- Local multiplayer support on a single PC
- Customizable table felt colors, lighting, camera angles, and ball designs
